thread:
rachel: Planning a focused admin entitlement tidying next Thu. Goal: reduce ownerless bindings and produce airtight artifacts for auditors. Need infra, ops, and legal input on format.
ben: Can we do a scoped dry-run first (single org) to validate we don't break infra agents?
lio: Yes. Proposed flow:
1) dry-run: list ownerless bindings + referenced KMS/bucket policies
2) artifact collection: binding json, KMS policy dump, ACLs, slack/email notif history
3) sample canary (3 projects) with infra guard enabled
4) prune & record evidence to compliance bucket
# Example commands I'll run:
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJ --format=json > $PROJ-iam.json
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/$PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/$KR/cryptoKeys/$KEY --format=json > $KEY-iam.json
aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket $BUCKET > $BUCKET-acl.json
sha256sum *.json > manifest.sha256
tar czf evidence-$PRINCIPAL.tar.gz *.json manifest.sha256
# upload
mc cp evidence-$PRINCIPAL.tar.gz s3://compliance-evidence/$RUN_ID/
lio: Add gpg detached-signatures per legal.
ops: We'll enable `--deny-absent-role` flag in infra-agent for the canary window so deploys fail loudly. Ops will run canary Fri 02:00 UTC (3 projects) and capture traces to /var/log/priv-prune/$RUN_ID.
ben: Recovery: implement `rebind-temp --principal X --ttl 1h` to quickly restore access and record event in audit. Also automated smoke tests post-prune.
sec-bot: IncidentBot: Created ticket TICKET-4932 "admin-entitlement-tidy planning" assigned to rachel, lio.
rachel: Action items: lio produce scripts + gpg signing, ben owns rebind-temp + smoke tests, ops runs canary and collects traces. Aim to ship sample canary Fri. Post artifacts to the ticket with checksums.
ops: Noted. We'll coordinate a short maintenance window and alert oncall.
rachel: Thanks. Keep updates brief here.
